claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the single HS2 configuration in proof.md (included doubled-cap CS1-C2 below n65536; otherwise its H=floor(sqrt(n)/16), Delta=floor(floor(log2 H)/2)-1 odd-stage stride, explicit revised source cap and fallback cap, unchanged 2-adic routine) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3. On every branch, including failures, discarded copies, retries and aborts, total charged sequential work is O(n^4(log2 n)2^(sqrt(2n))), hence the uniform representative is n^4(log2 n)2^(a sqrt n), where a is the exact positive rational coefficient declared below and proved >sqrt2 by the recurrence in cs1-base-proof.md Section0. Its exact growth index is1/2. All constants are absolute and all four bounds hold jointly for this one configuration under the clean-input error model.

For the same all-N, all-s HS2 configuration in proof.md, with n=ceil(log2 N) and unconditional full-secret success at least1-2^-8, every-branch peak allocated classical bits are O(n^2 2^(sqrt(2n)-2(2n)^(1/4))), hence O(2^(a sqrt n-2 n^(1/4))) for the exact rational a in the declared structured bound. The latter representative has exact growth index1/2. No root incidence vectors or analytic pool are stored; all fixed tables, controller scratch and aborted attempts are accounted. This bound holds jointly with the other three resources and clean fractional guarantee.

For the same HS2 algorithm and parameter configuration in proof.md, every N>=2 and every s, n=ceil(log2 N), every-branch peak accessible qubits are O(n), with exact representative n and growth index0. It includes all simultaneous tree siblings, arithmetic targets, label-extraction registers and measurement ancillas. This holds jointly with the stated work, classical bits and total source copies and unconditional full-secret success at least1-2^-8 under the clean-input model.

For the same all-N, all-s HS2 configuration in proof.md, n=ceil(log2 N), every execution branch acquires at most the explicit Q_Hcap=1024[6*2^MU*(KAP+1)(R K+2a2)+2a2] source copies on its main branch, with parameters defined exactly in proof.md; its finite branch uses the exact doubled-cap parent cap. Therefore total acquired copies, including discarded/rejected copies and all failed/retried attempts, are O(n^(3/2)2^(sqrt(2n))), hence representative n^(3/2)2^(a sqrt n) with the exact rational a in the declared structured object and exact growth index1/2. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and unconditional full-secret success at least1-2^-8 under the clean-input model.

For the same HS2 algorithm/configuration in proof.md, for every N>=2 and every secret s, the guaranteed malformed fraction is epsilon(n)=0. Every acquired copy must be an independent ideal coset state, so at most floor(epsilon(n)Q)=0 copies may be malformed. Under exactly this promise, unconditional full-secret success is at least1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four branchwise resource bounds. No positive robustness or maximal-tolerance claim is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
